input.content:
# Mini Template

A dependency-free TypeScript template renderer for Bun.

## Usage

### As a library

```typescript
import { render } from "./src/engine.ts";

render("Hello {{name}}!", { name: "World" });
// => "Hello World!"
```

### As a CLI

```sh
bun run src/cli.ts TEMPLATE_FILE DATA.json
```

Reads a UTF-8 template file and a JSON data file, writes the rendered text to
stdout. Errors are written to stderr and the process exits non-zero.

## Syntax

| Syntax | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `{{path.to.value}}` | HTML-escaped interpolation (`& < > " '` are escaped). |
| `{{{path.to.value}}}` | Unescaped interpolation. |
| `{{#if path}}...{{else}}...{{/if}}` | Conditional block (nestable). |
| `{{#each path}}...{{else}}...{{/each}}` | Iterate an array. |
| `{{this}}` | Current item inside `{{#each}}`. |
| `{{@index}}` | Zero-based index inside `{{#each}}`. |
| `{{! comment }}` | Comment, emits nothing. |

### Truthiness

Empty strings, `0`, `false`, `null`, `undefined`, and empty arrays are falsy;
all other values are truthy.

### Path resolution

Inside `{{#each}}`, `{{this}}` is the current item and `{{@index}}` is the
index. Normal paths (e.g. `{{user.name}}`) fall back to the root data object.
Use `{{this.property}}` to access properties of the current item.

### Missing values

Missing interpolation values render as an empty string.

### Errors

Structural mistakes (unknown block, mismatched/unclosed close, duplicate
`{{else}}`, `{{else}}` outside a block) throw a `TemplateError` with a line and
column. Values that cannot be rendered as scalar text (objects, arrays,
functions) also throw.

## Tests

```sh
bun test
```

part.text:
The implementation is complete. All 51 tests pass and the typecheck is clean.

## Summary

Built a dependency-free TypeScript template renderer for Bun:

**`src/engine.ts`** — the core renderer exporting `render(template, data)`:
- **Tokenizer** scans for `{{...}}` / `{{{...}}}` tags, tracking line/column positions
- **Parser** builds an AST, validating block structure (catches unclosed/mismatched/duplicate-else errors)
- **Renderer** walks the AST against data with a scope that tracks `root`, `this`, and `@index`

**`src/cli.ts`** — CLI that reads a template file + JSON data file, writes rendered text to stdout, and sends errors to stderr with non-zero exit.

**Features per spec:**
- `{{path}}` HTML-escaped (`& < > " '`), `{{{path}}}` unescaped
- `{{#if}}/{{else}}/{{/if}}` with nesting and correct truthiness (empty string, `0`, `false`, `null`, `undefined`, empty arrays = false)
- `{{#each}}` with `{{this}}`, `{{@index}}`, root-fallback paths, and nested loops (via `this.inner`)
- `{{! comment }}`, exact whitespace preservation, missing values → empty string
- `TemplateError` with line/column for structural mistakes; objects/arrays/functions throw instead of `[object Object]`
- No `eval`/`Function`/third-party packages in runtime code

**Tests** — 51 tests across `test/engine.test.ts` (unit) and `test/cli.test.ts` (CLI integration via `spawnSync`), covering all syntax, truthiness, error cases, and CLI behavior.
